integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the theorem, the support-parameter decomposition, both parameter branches, the sharp example, and the author’s explicit uniqueness expectation. The decisive sign computations were replaced by exact factorizations, and the normalized extremal pentagon was checked by exact rational shoelace arithmetic. Search noncoverage is treated as residual risk, not as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies equality only for the planar centroid–affine-regular-hexagon bound. It does not give a quantitative stability theorem or a higher-dimensional analogue. The proof uses the structural comparison reductions from Lassak’s published theorem and independently resolves the equality-critical algebra and reversal of Steiner symmetrization.
title: Equality rigidity in Lassak’s centroid–hexagon theorem
